_comment: Lane super-admin-2's screens as the super administrator (Rebeca Solís). Verbatim from origin/roles/super-admin-1's super-meridiano.json (the local API on 10 Sep 2026): /notifications/mine, /admin/companies, /admin/system/status, /admin/system-settings and the cross-tenant /surveys. Verbatim from this lane's read-only GETs as ana.rojas (10 Sep 2026): Grupo Meridiano S.A.'s /surveys/climate-trends, its /admin/ai-insights (empty), the question bank reads (empty) and the global question library and categories. Acme Corporation's rows (its two acknowledged AI insights and their details, their acknowledger, and its copies of the six global categories and twelve global questions) are shaped field-for-field from AIInsightDtos.cs and the library list rows, with the canvas's values, because this lane may not sign in as an Acme account; Acme's climate trends are deliberately absent (404), so its closed rows print their wave's place rather than a move. Shoot with --role super_admin --company '' --lang es --name 'Rebeca Solís', or --company 22cc8ed9-2e02-401a-8d52-52068ff5e6c0 for Acme chosen.
